newsitem.title: POLAND: Flemings positive on Polfa Kutno.
newsitem.headline: Flemings positive on Polfa Kutno.

text.p: Investors should buy shares of Polish drug maker Polfa Kutno, as the company's earnings are expected to rise due to its growing market share and competent management, Flemings Research said in a report.
"The company has products with good market shares and more consumer orientated than we had expected, with scope for growth from marketing and high prices," the report dated July 8 said.
The report said that despite Polfa's dispute with the tax authorities on VAT tax its 1997 profit forecast of 21-22 million zlotys could be achieved.@
"Profits of 21-22 million zlotys look possible, but there is a potential six million zloty negative extraordinary tax bill and fine," the report said.
Flemings also said the company's condition should further improve in 1998 due to inreasing pricing for non-regulated OTC products and sharp increase in spending on marketing and distribution.

"Outlook for 1988 is better - the new facility comes on line and share of faster growing OTC products with higher than average margins increases, while investment in distribution starts to impact," the report said. @
Flemings said Polfa Kutno should raise net profit to 21 million zlotys this year and 24.5 million zlotys next year from 16 million zlotys in 1996.
It said sales should rise to 218 million zlotys this year and 240 million zlotys next year from 171.2 million in 1996.
